goal: Implement the smallest manual URL/screenshot nomination adapter so a manual observation becomes the same bounded untrusted DiscoveryLead input consumed by the existing supervised discovery conveyor. Reuse existing exact identity, dedupe, JOBS/LOG persistence, first-party verification, gates, and Match Truth. Do not create a parallel manual pipeline, second identity architecture, new scoring model, package path, or submission automation.
acceptance_conditions: Manual URL and screenshot nominations become the same bounded raw observation shape already consumed by extract_discovery_leads/process_batch.
Manual observations remain untrusted discovery provenance and never directly become Employer Truth, Match Truth, Pursuit Truth, or package authority.
MANUAL_URL intake requires exactly one allowed absolute http/https discovery URL.
MANUAL_SCREENSHOT intake never performs OCR or screenshot parsing inside deterministic repository code; the operator/provider layer supplies structured fields plus a stable opaque source reference.
Repeated nomination of the same exact manual URL produces stable source identity and is idempotent.
Repeated nomination of the same screenshot source reference produces stable source identity.
Gmail and manual nominations resolving to the same exact employer/application-system identity plus exact requisition converge through the existing dedupe path.
Known discovery-platform identifiers never become canonical employer opportunity identity merely because a URL was manually nominated.
Unresolved manual nominations remain VERIFICATION_REQUIRED rather than receiving guessed identity.
Malformed manual observations fail explicitly and do not silently disappear.
Existing first-party identity resolution is reused unchanged and remains provider-neutral.
Existing permanent PURSUE, Bora review, and manual SUBMIT gates remain unchanged.
No package generation is introduced by manual discovery.
Focused tests and canonical full Assurance pass on the exact candidate bytes.
Independent adversarial review is required before promotion.
stop_conditions: Implementation requires changing exact-role identity semantics.
Implementation requires company+title, fuzzy title, discovery URL alone, or platform ID fallback identity.
Implementation requires modifying Match Truth, Candidate Truth, Employer Truth, gates, package logic, Gold sources, or submission policy.
Implementation requires screenshot OCR/browser automation inside deterministic repository code.
Implementation creates a second/manual-only downstream conveyor.
review_requirements: Normal independent reviewer remains Cursor when available. If Cursor is unavailable, stop before promotion unless Bora separately authorizes an alternate reviewer for the exact frozen candidate. No prior Claude exception carries forward.
